synopsis: IEC 62061 is presented as a machinery control-system safety standard using the Safety Integrity Level (SIL) scale, within a general machine-safety toolkit and linked to the parent standard IEC 61508 [f15260, f15267, f15268]. The booklet recommends ISO 13849 or IEC 62061 for the intervention chain in a safety-case skeleton, specifically where ISO 19014 does not reach [f12031, f15272]. That intervention path needs a performance-level or integrity assignment and fault testing; for a team starting from zero in October 2026, the broader safety-case skeleton is considered realistic by mid-2027 [f7455, f829]. Chapter 12 and the glossary identify IEC 62061:2021 as current but not reviewed, while other chapters leave its status or edition unverified and the glossary leaves its fit as an alternative to ISO 19014 unverified [f9769, f15267, f2354, f7455, f12054].
